Topline, interim or preliminary data from our clinical trials of CY200 or CY201 may not be representative of final results, and early results may not be predictive of the outcome of later-stage trials.

From time to time we may publish or report topline, interim or preliminary data from our clinical trials of CY200 or CY201, including topline data from the randomized Phase 2 trial of CY200 in CRPS Type 1 that our recent financings are intended to fund.

Topline, interim or preliminary data may not be indicative of the final results of a trial and are subject to the risk that one or more of the clinical outcomes may materially change as patient enrollment continues or as more patient data become available.
